cenas.trecho: O barco enchia de água, e os discípulos gritaram: Mestre, não te importas?
cenas.prompt_imagem: a small open wooden fishing boat with one small sail tossed by huge dark waves in a violent storm at night on the sea of Galilee, frightened men in ancient robes holding the mast, lightning in the clouds
cenas.prompt_movimento: the small boat rocks violently on huge crashing waves, rain pouring, lightning flashes, sails flapping in the wind

cenas.trecho: Jesus se levantou e disse ao mar: Aquiete-se! Acalme-se!

cenas.prompt_movimento: the robed man raises his arm toward the storm, his robe and hair blowing strongly in the wind, waves crashing around the boat

cenas.trecho: E o vento parou. Tudo ficou em completa calma.

cenas.prompt_movimento: the sea becomes calm and still, clouds slowly part and golden sun rays spread across the water, gentle ripples

cenas.trecho: A tempestade que te assusta também obedece a ele. Marcos quatro.

cenas.prompt_movimento: gentle golden sunrise light shimmering on calm water, the small boat drifts slowly, soft clouds moving

legenda:
Senhor, acalma a tempestade dentro de mim 🌊🙏
